visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit indoor living room where a man in a grey tank top stands behind a grey sectional sofa. A woman and a young boy sit on the sofa, looking upwards with focused expressions as they search for something flying. The man climbs onto the sofa cushions, pointing at the ceiling while the woman gestures towards the wall. The background features a minimalist white wall and a light-colored wooden table in the foreground. (2) The scene shifts to a bathroom doorway where the man, now wearing glasses, looks intensely at the ceiling. The bathroom interior shows white tiles and a glass shower door. The man points his finger and makes a determined facial expression while speaking. (3) A close-up of the woman in the bathroom shows her smiling and covering her mouth in realization. She points to a small black mosquito resting on the white wall tile. She quickly brings her hands together in a loud clap to crush the insect, followed by a triumphant celebratory gesture and facial expression. (4) The setting changes to an outdoor patio with greenery. The woman, now in a blue checkered dress with braided hair, talks directly to the camera. A young boy is shown with visible red mosquito bites on his cheek, ear, and legs. (5) Various Parakito repellent products are displayed on a stone ledge. The man and woman are seen applying the spray to the boy's limbs and attaching a blue repellent wristband to his arm. (6) The woman demonstrates a roll-on repellent product on her own arm, rubbing it in. The man sprays a green bottle towards the sky, creating a fine mist. (7) A white spherical repellent clip is shown attached to a baby's stroller. Inside the stroller, a baby in a yellow shirt looks at the clip. The woman's hands are seen inserting a repellent pellet into the clip. (8) The video concludes with the woman holding a green Parakito bottle towards the camera in a garden setting, smiling and gesturing for viewers to try it.
